name: Iron Rivet
summary: North of Lake Everstill, Iron Rivet shipments from Stormwind lie in gnoll camps. Foreman Oslow needs them to mend Lakeshire's damaged bridge.

sections.title: Stolen Caravan Cargo
sections.body: Lakeshire spent its iron making weapons and armor when Blackrock orcs attacked. After the assaults eased, Foreman Oslow asked Stormwind for supplies to mend the damaged Everstill Bridge. Redridge gnolls ambushed the caravan before it reached town. They hauled its wagons and pack beasts into the hills north of Lake Everstill, scattering iron rivets and pikes among their camps.

sections.title: Mending the Bridge
sections.body: Heavy iron rivets hold the Everstill Bridge's stone and timber frame together under carts and travelers. Foreman Oslow cannot safely repair it without them. The bridge links Lakeshire to the western valleys. Mending it will help secure the town's perimeter against further incursions.

faq.q: What are Iron Rivets used for?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow needs the iron rivets to repair Lakeshire's damaged Everstill Bridge. The town's original iron was melted down during the fighting with the Blackrock orcs.

faq.q: Why do the gnolls have these rivets?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls ambushed a Stormwind supply caravan and took its construction cargo. The rivets and iron pikes are now in their camps north of Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why was Lakeshire short on iron to begin with?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's defenders melted the town's stored iron to make swords, bullets, and armor during the orc invasion.

faq.q: Who is looking for these rivets?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow, who oversees the Everstill Bridge's restoration, is looking for the rivets.

angles.text: Stormwind forged these heavy fasteners for major building work, including stone and timber bridges.
Recovering the stolen supplies helps Lakeshire repair its infrastructure and curb the gnoll threat to the town.
